Fixed both issues:

1. **Dropdown menu background**: Added `className="bg-white"` to the `DropdownMenuContent` in TeamManagement.jsx so it has a solid white background.

2. **403 error when promoting to owner**: Updated the API endpoint to handle backward compatibility. It checks if a `SchoolManager` record exists for the requester; if not, it verifies the user is the original school manager associated with the school (via `schoolManagerInfo.organisme`). This allows promotion to owner even if a `SchoolManager` record hasn't been created yet.

The API now:
- First checks for a `SchoolManager` record with owner role
- Falls back to checking if the user is the original school manager
- Allows role changes if either condition is met

The dropdown should now have a visible background, and promoting to owner should work without a 403 error.

---

Updated the code to allow owners to perform role actions on themselves. Changes:

1. **Actions menu visible on yourself**: Changed the condition from `!manager.isCurrentUser && (canRemove || canChangeRoles)` to `(canChangeRoles || (canRemove && !manager.isCurrentUser))`. This shows the actions dropdown on yourself if you can change roles, and only hides deletion for yourself.

2. **API protection**: The API already prevents demoting the last owner (including yourself). If you're the only owner and try to demote yourself, the API blocks it with an error message.

As an owner, you can:
- See the actions dropdown on your own row
- Change your own role (e.g., demote yourself to admin or member), unless you're the last owner
- Still cannot delete yourself (which remains blocked)

The API will prevent demoting yourself if you're the last owner. To demote yourself, first promote another user to owner, then demote yourself.

Made the following updates:

1. **Backward compatibility**: If a manager being updated doesn't have a `SchoolManager` record yet, the API creates one automatically (similar to the requester check).

2. **Better error messages**: More descriptive error messages, especially when trying to demote the last owner.

3. **Improved logging**: Added console logs to help debug what's happening.

4. **Better frontend error handling**: The error message from the API is now displayed in the toast notification.

Try the action again. You should see:
- A more specific error message in the toast if something goes wrong
- Console logs on the server side showing what data is being sent

The 400 is likely one of these:
- Invalid role value (unlikely if using the UI)
- Attempting to demote the last owner — you'll see a message explaining you need to promote another user to owner first

Check your browser console and server logs to see the exact error. The toast should also show a clearer message.

+ import dbConnect from '@/lib/mongodb';
+ import SchoolManager from '@/models/SchoolManager';
+ import School from '@/models/School';
+ import User from '@/models/User';
+ import { getToken } from 'next-auth/jwt';
+ 
+ export default async function handler(req, res) {
+   if (req.method !== 'GET') {
+     return res.status(405).json({ message: 'Method Not Allowed' });
+   }
+ 
+   try {
+     await dbConnect();
+ 
+     const token = await getToken({ req, secret: process.env.NEXTAUTH_SECRET });
+     if (!token) {
+       return res.status(401).json({ message: 'Non autorisé' });
+     }
+ 
+     const userId = token.sub;
+ 
+     // Get all SchoolManager records for this user
+     const schoolManagers = await SchoolManager.find({
+       user: userId,
+       status: 'active'
+     })
+     .populate('school', 'name logo')
+     .lean();
+ 
+     // Also check for backward compatibility - if user is original school manager
+     const user = await User.findById(userId).lean();
+     if (user && user.role === 'school_manager' && user.schoolManagerInfo?.organisme) {
+       const legacySchoolId = user.schoolManagerInfo.organisme.toString();
+       
+       // Check if this school is already in the list
+       const alreadyInList = schoolManagers.some(
+         sm => sm.school._id.toString() === legacySchoolId
+       );
+ 
+       if (!alreadyInList) {
+         // Get the school
+         const legacySchool = await School.findById(legacySchoolId).lean();
+         if (legacySchool) {
+           // Add it as an owner (for backward compatibility)
+           schoolManagers.push({
+             school: legacySchool,
+             role: 'owner',
+             _id: null // No SchoolManager record exists yet
+           });
+         }
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     // Format the response
+     const schoolsWithRoles = schoolManagers.map(sm => ({
+       id: sm.school._id.toString(),
+       name: sm.school.name,
+       logo: sm.school.logo,
+       role: sm.role || 'owner', // Default to owner if not set
+       roleLabel: sm.role === 'owner' ? 'Propriétaire' : 
+                  sm.role === 'admin' ? 'Administrateur' : 
+                  sm.role === 'member' ? 'Membre' : 'Gestionnaire d\'école'
+     }));
+ 
+     res.status(200).json({ schools: schoolsWithRoles });
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error('Error fetching user schools:', error);
+     res.status(500).json({ message: 'Erreur interne du serveur' });
+   }
+ }
+ 
```

+

+           <School className="h-7 w-7 text-white" />
+         </div>
+         <Button onClick={handleCreateSchool} variant="outline">
+           <Plus className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />

+                   <School className="h-7 w-7 text-white" />
+                 </div>

+               <div className="text-left flex-1 min-w-0">
+                 <div className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 truncate">
+                   {selectedSchool?.name || 'Sélectionner une école'}
+                 </div>
+                 <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 flex items-center space-x-1">
+                   {selectedSchool && getRoleIcon(selectedSchool.role)}
+                   <span>{selectedSchool?.roleLabel || 'Gestionnaire d\'école'}</span>
+                 </div>

+             <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0" />

+         <DropdownMenuContent align="start" className="w-80 bg-white border border-gray-200 shadow-lg rounded-lg">
+           <div className="p-3 border-b border-gray-200">
+             <h3 className="font-semibold text-gray-900">Mes Écoles</h3>
+             <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">{schools.length} école(s)</p>
+           </div>
+           
+           <div className="max-h-64 overflow-y-auto">
+             {schools.map((school) => (
+               <DropdownMenuItem
+                 key={school.id}

Implemented a multi-school selector. Summary:

## Changes Made:

1. **New API Endpoint** (`/api/users/schools.js`):
   - Returns all schools the user manages with their role in each
   - Handles backward compatibility for users without SchoolManager records

2. **New Component** (`MultiSchoolSelector.jsx`):
   - Dropdown showing all schools the user manages
   - Displays school logo, name, and role (Propriétaire, Administrateur, Membre) with icons
   - "+" button to create a new school
   - Highlights the currently selected school

3. **Updated Dashboard** (`dashboard-manager/index.jsx`):
   - Replaced the static school display with the new selector
   - Added state management for selected school
   - Persists selection in localStorage
   - Clears selected campaign when switching schools

4. **Updated Hooks & APIs**:
   - `useSchoolData` now accepts a schoolId parameter
   - `school-info.js` API accepts an optional `schoolId` query parameter
   - Verifies user access when requesting a specific school

## Features:

- Shows all schools a user manages
- Displays the user's role for each school with icons
- "+" button at the end of the selector for creating new schools
- Smooth switching between schools
- Backward compatible with users who manage only one school

The selector appears in the dashboard header and allows switching between schools while showing your role in each.

## Issues Fixed:

1. **Campaigns hook call**: Previously passed `undefined` when a school was selected, breaking campaign loading. Now always uses the user ID and filters client-side.

2. **Campaigns API**: Updated to return campaigns from all schools the user manages (via SchoolManager relationships and backward compatibility), not just one school.

3. **Null safety**: Added checks in the schools API to handle null schools and prevent errors.

4. **Client-side filtering**: Campaigns are filtered by the selected school on the client side for accurate display.

## Current Flow:

1. **Multi-school selector**: Shows all schools the user manages with their role
2. **School selection**: Updates school data for the selected school
3. **Campaigns**: Fetches all campaigns, then filters by the selected school
4. **Backward compatibility**: Works for users with or without SchoolManager records

The implementation is now functional. Users who manage multiple schools can:
- See all their schools in a dropdown
- View their role for each school
- Switch between schools
- See campaigns filtered by the selected school
- Use the "+" button to create new schools (ready for implementation)

Everything should work as intended.

+         name: '',
+         address: '',
+         ville: '',
+         codePostal: '',
+         telephone: '',
+         email: '',
+       });
+       onClose();
+       if (onSchoolCreated) {
+         onSchoolCreated(data.school);
+       }
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('Error creating school:', error);
+       toast.error(error.message || 'Erreur lors de la création de l\'école');
+     } finally {
+       setLoading(false);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   return (
+     <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={onClose}>
+       <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[600px]">
+         <DialogHeader>
+           <DialogTitle className="flex items-center space-x-2">
+             <School className="h-5 w-5 text-blue-600" />
+             <span>Créer une nouvelle école</span>
+           </DialogTitle>
+           <DialogDescription>
+             Remplissez les informations ci-dessous pour créer une nouvelle école.
+           </DialogDescription>
+         </DialogHeader>
+ 
+         <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
+           <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
+             <div className="space-y-2">
+               <Label htmlFor="name">Nom de l'école *</Label>
+               <Input
+                 id="name"
+                 name="name"
+                 value={formData.name}
+                 onChange={handleChange}
+                 required
+                 placeholder="Ex: École primaire Jean-Pierre"
+               />
+             </div>
+ 
+             <div className="space-y-2">
+               <Label htmlFor="ville">Ville *</Label>
+               <Input
+                 id="ville"
+                 name="ville"
+                 value={formData.ville}
+                 onChange={handleChange}
+                 required
+                 placeholder="Ex: Montréal"
+               />
+             </div>
+           </div>
+ 
+           <div className="space-y-2">
+             <Label htmlFor="address">Adresse *</Label>
+             <Textarea
+               id="address"
+               name="address"
+               value={formData.address}
+               onChange={handleChange}
+               required
+               placeholder="Ex: 123 Rue de l'Éducation"
+               rows={2}
+             />
+           </div>
+ 
+           <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
+             <div className="space-y-2">
+               <Label htmlFor="codePostal">Code postal *</Label>
+               <Input
+                 id="codePostal"
+                 name="codePostal"
+                 value={formData.codePostal}
+                 onChange={handleChange}
+                 required
+                 placeholder="Ex: H1A 1A1"
+                 maxLength={20}
+               />
+             </div>
+ 
+             <div className="space-y-2">
+               <Label htmlFor="telephone">Téléphone</Label>
+               <Input
+                 id="telephone"
+                 name="telephone"
+                 type="tel"
+                 value={formData.telephone}
+                 onChange={handleChange}
+                 placeholder="Ex: (514) 123-4567"
+               />
+             </div>
+           </div>
+ 
+           <div className="space-y-2">
+             <Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label>
+             <Input
+               id="email"
+               name="email"
+               type="email"
+               value={formData.email}
+               onChange={handleChange}
+               placeholder="Ex: contact@ecole.com"
+             />
+           </div>
+ 
+           <DialogFooter>
+             <Button
+               type="button"
+               variant="outline"
+               onClick={onClose}
+               disabled={loading}
+             >
+               Annuler
+             </Button>
+             <Button type="submit" disabled={loading}>
+               {loading ? (
+                 <>
+                   <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
+                   Création...
+                 </>
+               ) : (
+                 'Créer l\'école'
+               )}
+             </Button>
+           </DialogFooter>
+         </form>
+       </DialogContent>
+     </Dialog>
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ export default CreateSchoolModal;

+ import dbConnect from '@/lib/mongodb';
+ import School from '@/models/School';
+ import SchoolManager from '@/models/SchoolManager';
+ import User from '@/models/User';
+ import { getToken } from 'next-auth/jwt';
+ 
+ const sanitizeString = (str) => {
+   if (!str) return '';
+   return str.normalize('NFC').trim();
+ };
+ 
+ export default async function handler(req, res) {
+   if (req.method !== 'POST') {
+     return res.status(405).json({ message: 'Method Not Allowed' });
+   }
+ 
+   try {
+     await dbConnect();
+ 
+     const token = await getToken({ req, secret: process.env.NEXTAUTH_SECRET });
+     if (!token) {
+       return res.status(401).json({ message: 'Non autorisé' });
+     }
+ 
+     const userId = token.sub;
+     const user = await User.findById(userId).lean();
+ 
+     if (!user || user.role !== 'school_manager') {
+       return res.status(403).json({ message: 'Seuls les gestionnaires d\'école peuvent créer une école' });
+     }
+ 
+     const { name, address, ville, codePostal, telephone, email } = req.body;
+ 
+     // Validate required fields
+     if (!name || !address || !ville || !codePostal) {
+       return res.status(400).json({ message: 'Les champs nom, adresse, ville et code postal sont requis' });
+     }
+ 
+     // Sanitize inputs
+     const sanitizedName = sanitizeString(name);
+     const sanitizedAddress = sanitizeString(address);
+     const sanitizedVille = sanitizeString(ville);
+     const sanitizedCodePostal = sanitizeString(codePostal);
+     const sanitizedTelephone = sanitizeString(telephone);
+     const sanitizedEmail = email ? email.toLowerCase().trim() : '';
+ 
+     // Validate lengths
+     if (sanitizedName.length < 1 || sanitizedName.length > 200) {
+       return res.status(400).json({ message: 'Le nom doit contenir entre 1 et 200 caractères' });
+     }
+ 
+     if (sanitizedAddress.length < 1 || sanitizedAddress.length > 200) {
+       return res.status(400).json({ message: 'L\'adresse doit contenir entre 1 et 200 caractères' });
+     }
+ 
+     // Create the new school
+     const newSchool = new School({
+       name: sanitizedName,
+       address: sanitizedAddress,
+       ville: sanitizedVille,
+       codePostal: sanitizedCodePostal,
+       telephone: sanitizedTelephone || '',
+       email: sanitizedEmail || '',
+       currentCampaignNumber: 0,
+       campaigns: [],
+       approved: false,
+       status: 'pending',
+       profileCompleted: false,
+     });
+ 
+     await newSchool.save();
+ 
+     // Create a SchoolManager record for the creator as owner
+     const schoolManager = new SchoolManager({
+       school: newSchool._id,
+       user: userId,
+       role: 'owner',
+       invitedBy: userId,
+       status: 'active',
+       joinedAt: new Date(),
+     });
+ 
+     await schoolManager.save();
+ 
+     res.status(200).json({
+       message: 'École créée avec succès',
+       school: {
+         id: newSchool._id.toString(),
+         name: newSchool.name,
+         logo: newSchool.logo,
+       }
+     });
+ 
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error('Error creating school:', error);
+     res.status(500).json({ message: 'Erreur interne du serveur', error: error.message });
+   }
+ }
+ 
```

## Changes completed

1. Removed the standalone "+" button — removed the separate button; the "Create new school" option only appears at the bottom of the dropdown.

2. Improved selector styling:
   - Larger, bolder school name (text-base, font-bold)
   - Improved spacing and padding
   - Better color scheme with role icons (amber for owner, blue for admin)
   - Enhanced dropdown with rounded corners and better shadows
   - Selected school has a blue highlight with border accent
   - Icon backgrounds with gradient styling

3. School creation functionality:
   - Created `CreateSchoolModal` component with a form (name, address, city, postal code, phone, email)
   - Created `/api/schools/create` API endpoint that:
     - Validates inputs
     - Creates the school
     - Creates a SchoolManager record with owner role
   - Wired the modal to open when clicking "Créer une nouvelle école"
   - After creation, the school list refreshes and the new school is automatically selected

The selector now:
- Shows schools with icons and role indicators
- Opens a modal when creating a new school (no more URL param changes)
- Refreshes the list after creation
- Has cleaner styling with improved visual hierarchy

Everything should now work as expected.
